title: Full disc of moon photographed by Apollo 17 crewmen during transearth coast
author: NASA
description: AS17-152-23311 (19 Dec. 1972) --- This full disc of the moon was photographed by the Apollo 17 crewmen during their trans-Earth coast homeward following a successful lunar landing mission in December 1972. Mare seen on this photo include Serentatis, Tranquillitatis, Nectaris, Foecunditatis and Crisium.
